name: Doc comments on the renderer and game loop code
body: Dean (2026-11-08): Nox and Nyx now have /** */ doc comments, shown by the language servers on hover, in signature help and in completion. Add them to the engine code, above all anything that touches the renderer and the game loop, explaining what each function, type and field does and why, so a reader can follow the code while writing a renderer of their own. Comments only: no behaviour changes, and the files must be identical once comments are stripped.
plan:
1. The game loop: engine/loop (GameLoop, Game), core/Time (FixedStepClock, FrameStats), the InputRouter's latching.
2. application/ (Application, ApplicationConfig, Programs).
3. sdl-facade/ core, window, platform, audio.
4. sdl-facade/renderer (GpuRenderer, GpuDevice, GpuPipelines, GpuShaders, GpuResources, GpuUniforms, GpuDrawList).
5. renderer/ (RenderBackend, RenderWorld, Camera, Frustum, Mesh, Texture, Primitives, Text, FontData, HeadlessRenderer) and the vector maths and colour helpers it uses.
6. The GLSL shaders in engine/shaders, with plain // comments explaining each stage.
7. Check with a comment-stripping diff that no code changed, then run the engine tests.
acceptance_criteria: Every type, field and function in the files above has a /** */ doc comment that explains intent, frame ordering, resource lifetimes or GPU concepts, not just the name.
Per-declaration // comments in those files become doc comments so they show on hover.
Stripping comments leaves every file byte-for-byte as it was.
The engine tests pass as before (189).
